items.title: With most information hidden, the game Stratego had stumped AI until now
items.title_zh: 新AI以不到DeepNash三十分之一的训练量击败顶尖Stratego人类玩家
items.title_en: New AI Beats Elite Stratego Players Using 34x Fewer Games Than DeepNash
items.summary: A new AI system learned to beat the best human Stratego players while using about 34 times fewer games than DeepNash, advancing imperfect-information game AI.

items.title: Greg Kroah-Hartman – Security in the LLM Age [video]
items.title_zh: Greg Kroah-Hartman 驳斥 Anthropic Mythos 的内核漏洞声明
items.title_en: Greg Kroah-Hartman Debunks Anthropic Mythos Kernel Vulnerability Claims
items.summary: Greg Kroah-Hartman's Kernel Recipes 2026 talk and HN discussion argue that Anthropic's Mythos model's '79 vulnerabilities' in the Linux kernel largely amounted to pattern-matching existing patches, with most findings being non-bugs, duplicates, or invented data, highlighting problems with LLM-driven security claims and attribution.

items.summary: Zig v0.17.0 release notes spark discussion on the language's evolution, LLM integration, and design merits.

items.summary: Google is reported to have released the frontier model Gemini 4 Argon, aimed at software engineering, enterprise work, and cybersecurity with autonomous vulnerability discovery and 1M-token output support.

items.title_zh: 2025年诺贝尔生理学或医学奖授予外周免疫耐受发现者
items.title_en: 2025 Nobel Prize in Medicine Awarded for Peripheral Immune Tolerance Discoveries
items.summary: The 2025 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine was awarded to Mary E. Brunkow, Fred Ramsdell, and Shimon Sakaguchi for their pioneering discoveries of peripheral immune tolerance mechanisms that prevent the immune system from attacking the body's own organs.
